versions.name: Sculpture
versions.description: Model a life-size head in clay, then carve or cast a smaller figure and pull a copy of a fruit or vegetable from a plaster mold you make yourself, handling sculptor's tools safely throughout.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
